deviations.what: sapUxAPObjectPageSubSectionTransparentBackground is @since 1.122 - ObjectPageSubSection's own JSDoc says "As of version 1.122, applications can set transparent background to subsections by adding the … class", and the rule behind it lives in themes/base/ObjectPageSubSection.less. The class IS the subject of this sample, kept 1:1 from the view. Below 1.122 it resolves to no rule at all: both subsections render identically and the sample demonstrates nothing - silently, since a CSS class is invisible to every gate. Undeclared until 2026-08-23; declaring it moves the port from src/01/03 to src/02/03.
